item.title: New work requirements for SNAP benefits go into effect Sunday
item.description: New work requirements for the Supplemental Nutrition Program, better known as SNAP, go into effect on Sunday. Thousands of Ohioans will be subject to the changes.

item.title: Report: Cavs complete 3-team trade with Kings and Bulls
item.description: ESPN’s Shams Charania is reporting that the Cleveland Cavaliers have completed a 3-team trade with the Sacramento Kings and Chicago Bulls. Cleveland acquires Dennis Schroeder and Keon Ellis in the deal.
